metaTitle: Custom 20 oz Moscow Mule Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 20 oz Moscow mule mugs for your brand. Perfect for promotions, events, and gifts. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 20 oz Moscow mule mugs offer a generous capacity that stands out from standard 16 oz or smaller options. The larger size makes them ideal for serving full cocktails or iced beverages at corporate events, trade shows, or as employee gifts. Copper-plated stainless steel construction keeps drinks cold longer, while the polished finish provides ample space for your logo via screen printing or etching. Choose 20 oz mugs when you want a substantial, premium promotional item that recipients will use repeatedly.
heroAltText: Custom 20 oz Moscow mule mugs with engraved logo, copper-plated stainless steel, perfect for brand promotions
